buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: Estevez gets a slim nod on freshness. Workload tilts to Estevez: 13 games in the last fortnight to Geerlings' 55. Over the last 7 days it is 2 matches for Geerlings against 1 for Estevez.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: A slight edge to Estevez on motivation and pressure. Estevez has the home crowd in Buenos Aires, Argentina, an added pressure point for Geerlings.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: Not enough to call on conditions; the small lean is to Geerlings. Geerlings has 4 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Estevez only 1, so the adjustment period is shorter.
